precisionIssues.notes: The later institutional review date is not the student application cutoff.
Cross-source year context disclosed. No earlier school deadline was overridden.

continuation.retryPolicy: No automatic repeat. NEU requires a valid TLS endpoint or separately evidenced official alternative; do not disable certificate checks. ZCMU needs a route-specific admissions notice. Future attempts use a distinct immutable batch and respect the shared scheduler cooldown.

limitations: Only deadline and intake/application-type scope were reviewed. Record SHA pins do not establish fresh approval of other fields.
No application portal acceptance was tested. No source supplied a time of day for these selected student deadlines; none was invented.
No cutoff was renewed, rolled to another year, or copied from the central guide to an unverified school.
School pages and school-authored PDFs provide their own dates. Reused central evidence is explicitly limited to Yunnan intake-year context.
Both original sandbox failures and recovered source observations remain preserved, without overwriting their receipts.
No canonical, Git or shared progress file was changed.
